scope_notes: Only edge-adjacent planar B-rep faces merge. Single NURBS surfaces and single-face B-reps are no-ops. Multi-face merging requires native-smlib. Mesh and SubD merging, face-component selection and MergeCoplanarFace remain unimplemented. No command options are accepted; distance and angle tolerances come from the document.

The existing usd-brep RemoveTopologicalEdgesAndVertices executive performs face and loop surgery. Native best-fit planes plus explicit absolute distances for every positive-weight surface control admit planar supports. The upstream best-fit helper reports a one-sided maximum gap; independent absolute control-plane distances guard that result. Groups use one fixed anchor plane and angular cutoff to prevent transitive plane drift. This conservatively rejects trimmed planar regions on nonplanar unused support; the native coincidence remover can decline additional cases.

All other edges, their surviving boundary vertices and pre-existing singular loop vertices are protected. Vertices belonging only to removed internal interfaces can disappear. Input and output boundary-intersection checks opt into manifold open sheets while existing solid-only callers retain their default admission. Crossed sheet interiors fail before mutation. No-op candidates avoid topology edits. Existing import/export and bounded intersection restrictions still apply; this is not a universal geometry-validity proof.

SmSurface::IsPlanar originally measured an inflated bounding box. A direct rotated exact plane with zone 1e-5 fails at requested tolerance 6.25e-7 and reports gap 1e-5. The generated repair requests the unexpanded bounding box and checks its status: the exact plane reports zero gap and passes, while the warped bilinear surface remains nonplanar. Baseline and corrected opt-in CMake targets use the same probe and otherwise identical patched libraries; the baseline overrides only SmSurface with the derivative-repaired version before the planarity repair.

The protected-topology patch moves the keep-edge check before IsTopological, which can expand surfaces as a side effect, and checks kept vertices before isolated-loop deletion. Generated sources compose this with existing blend and loop-owner repairs; the pinned upstream checkout is unchanged.

Modeling uses private localized copies. Every selected source stages before replacements. Identity, attributes, groups and selection survive one batch Undo/Redo transaction. Later unsupported or native-geometry failure preserves previous geometry and Redo. Prepared commits reject changed geometry or document tolerances. No-op commands preserve Redo. Command admission bounds faces and aggregate surface controls before native import; the native path repeats the limits.

Native geometry checks cover adjacent triangles, an annulus retaining its inner loop and boundary vertices, disconnected regions, a triangulated closed box, a rational closed interface between a planar disk and its surrounding region, unchanged kinked faces and cylinder seams, and rejection of crossed sheet interiors. Independent areas are 12, 8, 2, 52 and 36; the closed box volume is 24. Original source geometry remains unchanged.

The six actual-command recipes check rectangle, translated rectangle at (1000000,-2000000,3000000), annulus, triangulated box, disconnected regions and a kinked no-op. Face counts, removed counts, sorted loop counts, analytic areas and box volume match. Native tight boundary extents are independently checked within 1e-7 on all six. Conservative control bounds can include unused expanded supports, so they are not used as shape extents in the oracle.

Public SDK recipes construct an owned Brep.CreateFromMesh(mesh, True), dispose the temporary mesh, and call DuplicateBrep and MergeCoplanarFaces(distance, angle) per iteration. Mocks check strict finite inputs, method routing, no-ops, null/invalid/inconsistent topology, mass/bounds failures and owned resource cleanup. They do not establish licensed Rhino parity. Fresh captures remain pending the recorded Wine SSPI startup blocker.

Native regressions pass with AddressSanitizer instrumentation on both complete native libraries and the C ABI. Leak detection and optional stack-use-after-return detection are disabled; ordinary validation and exact export checks remain enabled. One pre-existing thin-polar-cap boundary test stays ignored for pathological runtime. Historical records retain original hashes through immutable Git references; 69 already-unverifiable records remain unchanged. The final native helper explicitly rejects nonpositive or nonfinite surface weights before invoking the control-hull admission test; all seven coplanar cases pass again under instrumentation after this guard.
